changes: Generate beside Add opens a separate editable journal window using saved templates. Enter the business lines, description and rates, then Generate fills the actual debit and credit cells.

The generator completes missing mapping, payroll, withholding and FX lines, reuses existing lines and recalculates generated amounts without duplicates. It supports configured foreign currencies and flags missing accounts, rates or inconsistent business amounts.
Generator drafts are retained separately by account and template. Use in Post Entry copies the completed journal for normal explicit posting.
